 “Vengeance Shall Be Mine!”: New ‘Gilded Age’ Trailer Delivers Major Drama (and a Season 4 Release Date) 
 Is it time once more to return to the decadent drama of HBO ‘s The Gilded Age ? 
 The Gilded Age is HBO’s massive hit period drama from Julian Fellowes , the mastermind behind Downton Abbey , and co-creator and co-showrunner Sonja Warfield . The series is set in 1880s New York, where the fussy aristocrats of the “Old New York” must contend with the arrival of super rich robber barons, railroad tycoons, and oil magnates who made their riches on their own. 
 Carrie Coon stars as Bertha Russell, a character loosely inspired by the real life society queen Alma Vanderbilt, and Morgan Spector is her roguish husband, George Russell. Season 3 ended with the usually aligned couple split after Bertha went against George’s wishes and wed their beloved daughter Gladys (Taissa Farmiga) to an English duke (Ben Lamb). Even though Gladys grew to love the Duke of Buckingham — and finished the season excitedly telling her mother she was pregnant — George couldn’t forgive Bertha for her ruthless streak. 
 Elsewhere in the show, the dashing Dr. William Kirkland (Jordan Donica) proposed to Peggy Scott (Denée Benton), an alliance was forged between wealthy widow (and former ladies maid) Enid Winterton (Kelley Curran) and the closeted Oscar Van Rhijn (Blake Ritson), and footman Jack Trotter (Ben Ahlers) officially left service and embraced the life of a self-made inventor.
 What new dazzling party scenes await us in The Gilded Age Season 4? Will Larry (Harry Richardson) and Marian (Louisa Jacobson) reunite? Will George come home to Bertha? 
 When does the new season of The Gilded Age come out on HBO Max? Here’s everything we know…
 Photo: HBO 
 Is There a New Episode of The Gilded Age on Tonight (10/25/26)?
 Alas, there is no new episode of The Gilded Age on HBO or HBO Max tonight. 
 When Does The Gilded Age Season 4 Come Out? The Gilded Age Season 4 Premiere Date and Time:
 The Gilded Age Season 4 comes out on Sunday, November 1 at 9 PM ET on HBO and HBO Max.
 Where is The Gilded Age Streaming?
 The Gilded Age is an HBO original, which means you will need a subscription to either HBO or its official streaming platform, HBO Max. 
 If you’re new to HBO Max , you can sign up for as low as $10.99/month with ads, but an ad-free subscription will cost $18.49/month.
 SUBSCRIBE TO HBO MAX FOR AS LOW AS $10.99/MONTH 
 BUNDLE HBO MAX WITH DISNEY+ AND HULU FOR $19.99/MONTH 
 If you want to stream even more and save a few bucks a month while you’re at it, we recommend subscribing to one of the discounted Disney+ Bundles with Hulu and HBO Max. With ads, the bundle costs $19.99/month and without ads, $32.99/month.
 Photo: HBO 
 How Many Episodes are in The Gilded Age Season 4?
 There are eight episodes in total in The Gilded Age Season 4, with new episodes premiering on Sundays at 9 PM ET from November 1 to December 20. Here’s your guide to when all eight episodes come out on HBO and HBO Max:
 Season 4 Episode 1: Sunday, November 1 at 9 PM ET
 Season 4 Episode 2: Sunday, November 8 at 9 PM ET
 Season 4 Episode 3: Sunday, November 15 at 9 PM ET
 Season 4 Episode 4: Sunday, November 22 at 9 PM ET
 Season 4 Episode 5: Sunday, November 29 at 9 PM ET
 Season 4 Episode 6: Sunday, November 6 at 9 PM ET
 Season 4 Episode 7: Sunday, November 13 at 9 PM ET
 Season 4 Episode 8: Sunday, November 20 at 9 PM ET
 Photo: HBO 
 What Year Does The Gilded Age Take Place?
 HBO’s The Gilded Age takes place — get this — during the time period known as “The Gilded Age,” which spanned from 1877-1900. 
 The Gilded Age Season 1 takes place in 1882, Season 2 is set in 1883, Season 3 covered 1884, and the new season takes place in 1885.
 Will There Be a Gilded Age Season 5 on HBO?
 We don’t know yet! HBO has yet to announce if there will a fifth season of The Gilded Age . However, given the show’s massive popularity and critical success, we’re cautiously optimistic for The Gilded Age Season 5.
